findings.summary: No single focus: one Node/Leaf memory change bundled with unrelated restyles, dead-code rewrites, ABC change, and eq/repr dataclass changes
Headline memory number has no reproducible source, and __slots__ saves nothing for mypyc-compiled wheels
Description's allocation claims are contradicted by the diff (dead pattern code, extra copies, used_names still built, unreachable guard)
Stale Node.__init__ docstring mentions removed context argument
Constructor contracts changed by packing ifs into or (prefix, children aliasing); no caller hits it
Slots that do nothing (empty __slots__ on classes with dict-bearing bases, unused logger slot)

why: Finding 1 states the maintainer's reason directly (no focus, many unrelated stylistic rewrites bundled under a memory change), and finding 2 covers the mypyc performance-claim problem.
